title: Normalization boundary
description:
Explain splitting orders and customers using a foreign key, the update anomaly avoided, when to denormalize a read model, and how to keep duplicated data consistent.

Write a structured explanation. This is a transparent keyword rubric, not an AI architect or proof of a sound design. Check every tradeoff yourself; a rubric pass demonstrates coverage only.

reference.text:
Explain splitting orders and customers using a foreign key, the update anomaly avoided, when to denormalize a read model, and how to keep duplicated data consistent.
Normalize the source of truth to reduce update anomalies. Denormalization is a deliberate consistency/latency tradeoff, not a blanket performance rule.
